prompt: A small alpine timber cottage with a stone plinth, a steep red gabled roof, a sheltered front porch, evenly spaced wooden posts and railings, shuttered windows, a front door and a stone chimney. Warm cream plaster between dark timber framing, subtle roof overhangs, and simple solid architectural detail. A cohesive game-ready building viewed from all sides.

widthScale.label: Width Scale
widthScale.description: Scales the entire cottage horizontally, including its architectural details.

depthScale.label: Depth Scale
depthScale.description: Scales the cottage, porch and steps along the front-to-back axis.

woodColor.label: Wood Detail Color
woodColor.description: Colors the door, decking and railings, with coordinated lighter accents.

roofColor.label: Roof Color
roofColor.description: Includes coordinated tile-course and ridge-cap shades.

stoneColor.label: Stone Color
stoneColor.description: Tints the foundation, steps, chimney and mortar while preserving masonry variation.

roofOverhang.label: Roof Side Overhang
roofOverhang.description: Horizontal extension beyond each side wall, before object scaling.

roofCourses.label: Roof Tile Courses
roofCourses.description: Number of raised tile-course strips on each roof slope.

railingCount.label: Front Railing Balusters
railingCount.description: Balusters per front railing section; side sections use a proportionate count.

lanternIntensity.label: Lantern Glow
lanternIntensity.description: Emissive intensity of the lantern glass; does not add a light source.
